title: durabilityframe
summary: MSUI now implements the current Benilla durability alert: exact absolute 1..5 damaged and zero/force-red broken classification with wrapped-item suppression, all eight body glyphs as one figure, separate main-hand/off-hand/ranged alerts, shield versus off-hand-weapon substitution, exact UI-Durability-Icons atlas cells and colors, and managed seating between the dynamic quest-timer window and quest-watch tracker. Deterministic checks pass; live equipment-stream and pixel verification remain open.

openItems.text: Entire DurabilityFrame surface: inventory-alert status computation (damaged <20% / broken), the 11-region atlas figure, show/hide law, and minimap-relative managed seating
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-21: Added DurabilityFrameUiLaw plus the HUD renderer with current Benilla's exact 11-slot map, absolute 1..5 yellow threshold, broken/force-red/wrapped gates, atlas UVs, body/show-separate law, off-hand glyph swap and side-glyph 20px managed offset. The figure now moves below a shown QuestTimerFrame, and the quest tracker moves below both dynamic managed frames.

openItems.text: Implemented but needs live-session verification with body-only, main-hand, shield, off-hand weapon and ranged durability transitions plus a scaled pixel comparison.
